title: Full Gabor frames, its existence problem, and a non-uniform Balian-Low type theorem
summary: For a broad class of Delone sets in $\mathbb{R}^n$ that are of significance in both mathematics and physics, we prove a non-uniform Balian-Low type theorem and settle the converse problem on the existence of Gabor frames, for arbitrary dimension $n$. To this end, we introduce a class of Gabor frames, termed full Gabor frames, and prove that the existence of such a frame on the Delone set with Schwartz window functions is equivalent to the condition that the lower Beurling density be strictly greater than one.
